title: Aether-Lang: a Rust runtime for topological machine learning
description: Aether-Lang is a Rust workspace for a small language runtime, a bounded topological computation core, ML primitives, and a sparse-event kernel prototype. The project uses topology as a systems signal: embeddings, residuals, binary streams, and scheduler state are converted into geometric or topological objects, then used for execution, diagnostics, convergence checks, or pruning. Includes a Lean 4 verified kernel.
